article.title: Healing the World Spirit
article.author: Guest Author
article.content: The opinions expressed here are solely the author's and do not reflect the opinions or beliefs of the LA Progressive. Inspired by Dr King’s call for “a spiritual revolution in values.” Diagnosis, Most of our societal challenges are the end result of a society whose values are void of spiritual considerations. We worship wealth and the wealthy which are outgrowths of prioritizing financial profit at the expense of life itself. We are totally unbalanced by injustice, making lies the order of the day. We regard dominators with awed respect which generates unimaginable cruelty. What is happening in Gaza is fatal spiritual sickness. It is terrorism inflicted on our citizens, who in the majority do not want their taxes funding atrocity and are traumatized by viewing it. The inability to be affected by this is also a trauma response. All of us are in dire need of healing. Gaza’s oppression is part of a strategy for crushing dissent, enlarging societal insanity guaranteeing widespread powerlessness and normalizing genocide, which is the plan for most of us. A new world of peace is possible with the implementation of a new valuation of spiritual health as necessary to our survival. The imbalance created by a value system that prizes the material or financial profit above all else is obvious. Our technological capacities so far outstrip our spiritual capacities that we are in danger of destroying all that is worth living for, if not our lives. The current meme "4 BILLION dead” is worth deeper consideration. We are on that ledge. It rivals any holocaust or disaster that human beings on this earth have ever experienced. This is where technological growth with no spiritual consciousness has landed us. Dr King’s call for “ a spiritual revolution in values” is our last best hope of surviving as a species with anything worth living for intact. Healing Modalities Uniting with new ways to live has become a global emergency. May we unite with the principles of Reverence for all that live, Balance in the form of justice so that all may live and prize Compassion primarily, overriding punitive and sadistic practices that presently dominate our lives and consciousness and threaten our survival. We use various tripartite forms to implement change because three is the number most aligned with change. Reverence, Balance & Compassion are capitalized here for clarity and emphasis. If we are to live, in the best sense of the word, we implement changes based on basic spiritual principles, capable of uniting people of all religions and ways of being. Peace is a result of living by these principles. Reverence is interwoven with love of life. Reverence which bears fruits of wonder, awe and humility are a part of every major religion on earth, however we should seriously consider going beyond the limitations of religious practices (while not banishing them because some are very useful), aligned as they are with institutions. Institutions are, by nature morally ambiguous and usually malevolent in their search for funding as their highest priority and often twisted too easily into harmful dogma. It is in the so called mystical traditions of major religions that spiritual wisdom may be found. Authentic spiritual growth may only be possible outside the strictures of most institutions, unless they are monasteries and even then it is limited. For spiritual growth to be widespread it must grow in the soil of all basic human rights, which are in dire need of update and expansion, being the rule rather than the exception. This would be a result of a value system that places spiritual health, in all of its infinite diversity, as a primary value. Liberty cannot exist without Balance in the form of justice. Balance is interwoven with justice. There can be no justice without truth. Living in truth is at the center of spiritual health. The definition of spiritual health must take into account the holistic nature of our existence. Balance is for us all. Poverty and oppression degrade not only the environment by the imbalance of the natural order, but also the human spirit. Compassion is the ability to see through the eyes of love, for everyone. This is a practice undergirded by spiritual health and spiritual practices which vary so widely because of their infinite variety that the freedom of possessing basic human rights, the definition of which must be expanded and treated as a building principle of the highest order, is essential. To enable the freedom to practice these modalities everywhere in all their infinite variety is the only guarantee of widespread human spiritual health. This is a fruit of Compassion implemented as a universal value. There can be no civil society without Compassion as a primary principle. Compassion is rooted in understanding holistic reality, or the interconnection of all life on this planet. The practice of Compassion generates understanding of the reality of wholistic unity. Unitive Consciousness One antidote is living in a world where wholistic visions are infinite and all decisions of import revolve around the core principle of “Do no harm” as primary directive. Is there a better directive? Wholistic vision is rooted in the practice of Compassion. We all wish for a deeper sense of Life. Liberty and the Pursuit of Happiness, none of which are possible without Reverence, Balance & Compassion as widespread universal practice & principles. The caveat is the replacement of “the pursuit of happiness” with a triumvirate of peace, contentment and bliss. Life is God. The life spirit is divinity. Liberty, or freedom, is not and never will be sustainable while most of us are oppressed by slavery. Happiness as an ideal is over rated, one might even say childish if not superficial. It is aligned with the selfishness that is killing us all. Peace and contentment are priceless antidotes to so much that ails us and are a practice of discipline rather than the giddy self delusion of chance when it indulges us, usually labelled as “happiness.". Reverence and awe are bliss when generated by the wonders of the life spirit. The book Ways of Being, Animals, Plants, Machines: the search for Planetary Intelligence , by James Bridle, illuminates the Unitive forms of intelligence utilized by many so called “lower forms”of life to live. There is a life spirit and many beings have far surpassed us in their abilities to live in alignment with it in ways we do not understand. Perhaps this understanding will require a new humility. The pursuit of happiness is an outmoded idea. The contentment, peace and bliss which, if we are fortunate, replaces the search for the more materially oriented “happiness", are spiritual in nature. The pursuit of happiness is aligned with craving which produces suffering. Planetary Peace is not possible without a widespread valuation of Compassion as a central principle of our culture(s). Yes, the world and life itself are by nature problematic with death, sickness and the unpredictability of nature expanded in our interiors because we fear this darkness and deny it thereby strengthening destructive power through fear. We can do so much better. This goal is an integral part of our largest task in life. The operative word here is “we.” It is the holding together of opposites that is the ultimate form of peacemaking. Black and white without grey are a game board cartoon all about war. Shades of grey are not only about dominator games but part of an educational process of understanding the infinite beauty, complexity and holistic integrity of life itself. Virginia Bryant Virginia Bryant is an award winning artist/painter currently working in upstate New York.
